# RuDao SEO Promotion Guide
# Tony Tong (唐儀) — RuDao.us · TonyTong.cc
# Generated by WorkBuddy AI

## STATUS: All technical SEO is deployed. Manual submissions below.

---

## 1. GOOGLE SEARCH CONSOLE

### Step 1: Add your property
- Go to: https://search.google.com/search-console
- Click "Add Property"
- Enter: https://rudao.us
- Verify ownership (DNS method via Cloudflare):
  * Google will give you a TXT record
  * Add it in Cloudflare Dashboard > DNS > TXT record
  * Wait 5-10 minutes, click "Verify"

### Step 2: Submit your sitemap
- In Search Console, go to "Sitemaps"
- Enter: sitemap.xml
- Click "Submit"
- Also submit: https://rudao-tonytong.pages.dev/sitemap.xml

### Step 3: Request indexing
- Go to "URL Inspection"
- Enter: https://rudao.us
- Click "Request Indexing"
- Also request: https://rudao.us/#author, https://rudao.us/#contents, etc.

### Step 4: Monitor keywords
- After 3-7 days, check "Performance" for impressions
- Target keywords: RuDao, 儒道, Tony Tong, 唐儀, Beyond The Art of War

---

## 2. BAIDU WEBMASTER (百度站长)

### Step 1: Add site
- Go to: https://ziyuan.baidu.com
- Login with Baidu account
- Add site: https://rudao.us
- Verify: Add Baidu's meta tag or DNS verification

### Step 2: Submit sitemap
- Go to "普通收录" (Normal Indexing)
- Submit: https://rudao.us/sitemap.xml

### Step 3: Submit individual URLs
- Use "链接提交" (Link Submission) tool
- Submit all 12 URLs from your sitemap

### Step 4: Monitor
- Keywords to track on Baidu: 儒道, 唐儀, 儒将, 超越孙子兵法, 竞合之道, 儒商

---

## 3. BING WEBMASTER TOOLS

### Step 1: Add site
- Go to: https://www.bing.com/webmasters
- Add: https://rudao.us
- Verify via DNS (Cloudflare) or meta tag

### Step 2: Submit sitemap
- Submit: https://rudao.us/sitemap.xml

### Step 3: IndexNow (instant indexing)
- Bing supports IndexNow for instant URL submission
- Submit: https://api.indexnow.org/IndexNow (POST with your URLs)

---

## 4. AI SEO — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI

### What's already done:
- ✅ llms.txt deployed at https://rudao.us/llms.txt
- ✅ robots.txt allows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai
- ✅ JSON-LD structured data (Book, Person, FAQ, Breadcrumb)
- ✅ Comprehensive keyword coverage in structured data

### How AI search engines discover your content:
- **ChatGPT (GPTBot)**: Crawls web pages with GPTBot user-agent. Your robots.txt allows it. The llms.txt gives it a clean summary.
- **Perplexity (PerplexityBot)**: Crawls and indexes web content for answers. Your robots.txt allows it.
- **Claude (ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai)**: Crawls for training. Your robots.txt allows it.
- **Google AI (Google-Extended)**: Crawls for Google's AI Overviews. Your robots.txt allows it.

### To boost AI discoverability:
1. **Get mentioned on Wikipedia/Wikidata**: Create a Wikidata entry for "RuDao (book)" and "Tony Tong"
2. **Get reviewed on Goodreads**: When the book launches, create a Goodreads listing
3. **Publish articles**: Write guest posts on Medium, LinkedIn Articles, Substack
4. **Create YouTube content**: The HKBA YouTube channel can feature RuDao content
5. **Get backlinks**: From TonyTong.cc, HKBA.cc, Crunchbase, LinkedIn

## 7. FILES DEPLOYED

| File | URL | Purpose |
|------|-----|---------|
| robots.txt | https://rudao.us/robots.txt | Crawl directives for all engines + AI bots |
| sitemap.xml | https://rudao.us/sitemap.xml | 12 URLs for Google/Baidu/Bing |
| llms.txt | https://rudao.us/llms.txt | Machine-readable summary for AI engines |
| JSON-LD (in HTML) | https://rudao.us/ (inline) | Book + Person + FAQ + Breadcrumb schema |
| Open Graph (in HTML) | https://rudao.us/ (inline) | Social sharing (Facebook, LinkedIn) |
| Twitter Card (in HTML) | https://rudao.us/ (inline) | Twitter/X sharing |
| Canonical URL | https://rudao.us/ | Primary URL for all search engines |
